utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Dane. I’ve heard it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room, but I still want to confirm who’s handling the sign-in sheet before I call it settled.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Morning, Eli—thanks, that lines up with what I heard from Leo. I can help sort drop-offs the first hour, and if nobody’s on sign-in yet I can cover or find someone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a sensible offer, Dane; let’s put you down for sorting from 10 to 11, and please check whether sign-in is covered before noon so we have a firm plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, I’m checking repair drive details around school pickup—do you know if Saturday late morning is still the plan, and where folks should drop tools or parts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only skimmed the details, but Leo told me it’s still on this weekend and he’ll confirm if the time changes—late morning sounds likely. For tools or parts, I’d check the porch table or community room since Opal’s tracking where those things land.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll tell Opal porch table or community room are the likely drop spots for now, and I’ll wait for Leo’s confirmation before planning around the kids.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Gus, the repair drive is still on this weekend. Bring simple-fix items, and I’ll share the final time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Leo—I'll keep my tools ready and tell folks to bring simple-fix items while we wait on the final time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Tools will help a lot—please tell folks to label their items with name and phone number too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I’m helping with Saturday morning setup and bringing some tools—what do you need most for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s a big help. What we need most right now is someone to lead the tool table and a quick check-in list for folks dropping off small appliances or bikes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can lead the tool table, and I’ll make a simple check-in list for appliances and bikes so drop-offs stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Uli, before I put anything on the repair drive list, can you confirm whether we’re focusing on bikes, small appliances, and clothing mends for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that sounds right—bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends for Saturday morning. Maybe note that folks can bring small tools or parts if they have them, but no pressure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—I’ll note bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends for Saturday morning, with optional small tools or parts if people already have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, the repair drive still needs spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and folks handy with bicycles or small appliances—can you check what you have and invite a couple nearby?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll check my bins for screws, cords, and gloves now, and I’ll invite a couple neighbors who know bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Cleo—I’ll let Tess know you’re checking supplies and keep nudging Nell and the others so we cover the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you ask the office today if the community room can be the drop-off spot, and who do you want as the second person on the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll check with the office today before we say anything definite. For the repair list, I’d like you as the second person if you’re willing, so we can cross-check entries.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I’ll be the second person on the list. Ask the office about Saturday morning too, since Ira can cover a table shift then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m catching up as I go—do you know where and when I should bring the socket set and screwdrivers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I wouldn’t head over yet, Ira—I’m still waiting for Pia to confirm the time, location, and whether they’re accepting tools like that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks Kira—I’ll hold onto the tools for now and wait for Pia’s confirmation before bringing anything over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, I’m still confirming the repair drive details, but so far I’ve heard it may be this weekend for broken small appliances and tools. Eli wants us to settle the date, drop-off spot, and sign-in person, and I’ll pass that along once it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that matches what Hana and I were narrowing toward, though I’d add bikes and simple clothing mends if we have helpers. Let’s tentatively say Saturday morning in the community room, and I can help find a sign-in person once the room is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Jules—I’ll repeat it as tentative for now: Saturday morning in the community room, with small appliances, tools, maybe bikes and simple mends if helpers come through, and you’ll help find a sign-in person once the room’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Tess, I’m trying to help with the repair drive, but I’d better not pretend I’ve got the details straight—do you know if we’re collecting tools and small parts today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good of you to check, Oren—yes, we still need spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves, but the actual repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thank you, Tess—that’s exactly the sort of thing I’d have muddled up. I’ll spread the word: spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the repair drive Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rey, I’m pulling together the list of broken items and who can bring tools today—can you help confirm the tool table or check in with any volunteer fixers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can quietly check in with the volunteer fixers and confirm what Lila’s bringing for the tool table. I’ll be careful not to promise anything until I’ve heard back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that’s perfect. Just send me what you hear back, and I’ll fold it into the repair drive list today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Nell, I’m keeping the repair drive location list tidy—do you know where your items or sign-up sheets should be marked?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Opal—what I’ve heard second-hand is that broken small appliances and tools are being collected at the community room this Saturday morning, and Rosa may be setting up a sign-up sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—I’ll mark broken small appliances and tools at the community room for Saturday morning, and I’ll check with Rosa before I pin down the sign-up sheet spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, I’m catching up fast—do you know what needs fixing, or can you bring any basic tools this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Bo, I don’t have the confirmed fix list yet—so far I’ve only heard small appliances and tools this weekend. If you can bring basic tools, that’d help, and I’ll pass along the settled plan once Eli and I pin down the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik—small appliances and tools is enough for me to plan around for now. I’ll try to bring basic tools, and just send me the final list when you and Eli have it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, I’m pulling the repair drive pieces together—could you help spread the word that the community center front porch is our main drop-off, with pickup points at Maple Court and the laundromat bulletin board?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll pass that along to the school parents and note the community center porch as the main drop-off, plus Maple Court and the laundromat bulletin board as pickup points.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Faye—that’s perfect, and if you can mention we’re especially hoping for small appliances and bike repairs, that would help folks know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Sam—just so I don’t muddle it, the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, right? I’m bringing tape and spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s right, Oren—Saturday morning in the community room. Tape and spare batteries will be really useful, and I’ll be there early with screwdrivers and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—that helps it stick. I’ll bring the tape and batteries, and I’ll try not to leave them sitting by my front door.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d tell folks we’re aiming for Saturday morning in the community room, with bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends—just say we’ll confirm the room as soon as it’s booked.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—Saturday morning in the community room, focusing on bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends, with the room still to be confirmed. I’ll phrase it carefully so I don’t make it sound fully booked yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Noah—thank you. If you can also ask who might bring tools or spare parts, that’ll help us match people up without overpromising.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira — I’m pulling together the broken-items list today and checking who can bring tools; could you help confirm the tool table or reach out to a couple volunteer fixers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Mara — I already promised a Saturday morning table shift and can bring my socket set and screwdrivers, so I’ll also ask around today for a couple more volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I’ll mark you down for the Saturday morning table shift and those tools, and I really appreciate you asking around for more fixers today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, the repair drive’s this Saturday morning in the community room—can you spread the word and bring any spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, or bike/appliance know-how?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—I’ll spread the word today. I’ve got spare screws and work gloves, and Sam’s bringing two extension cords and a folding table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic, Leo—thank you! I’ll let Tess know you’ve got screws and gloves covered, and that Sam’s bringing cords and a table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m jumping in late—sounds like Saturday at 10 by the community room is the plan; where would you most use me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. If you could help set up a small sorting table at 10 and point folks toward tools, screws, or lamps, that would take a lot off me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, I can do that—I'll be there at 10 to set up the sorting table and help steer folks to the right supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, have you heard about the repair drive yet? We’re gathering spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and handy folks for bikes, lamps, toasters, and little fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits second-hand, but that matches what Quinn and Rosa mentioned—small appliances, bikes, and a Saturday morning community room drop-off. I can help pass along the call for supplies and handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Nell, thank you—please tell folks Saturday morning in the community room, and that we especially need those supplies plus anyone comfortable fixing bikes, lamps, or toasters.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, can you help with either the repair list or a Saturday shift, and do you have any tools we can count on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina—I can take a Saturday morning shift and help sort the repair list. You can count on my drill set, clamps, and a few spare hand tools too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I’ll put you down for Saturday morning with Ira and mark your tools. Can you and Pia share the repair list so every urgent fix gets assigned?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Hana—yes, I’ve got the details now: this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room. They’re taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, and mending projects, but no big electronics or hazardous items.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—that helps. Before I spread the word, do we know who’s already signed up to help at the tables?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the helper list yet, Hana, so I’d hold off on naming volunteers. I’ll ask Tess who’s covering the tables and the sign-in sheet, then we can pass along one clear notice.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Cleo — from what I’ve heard so far, repeat needs are screws, basic tools, old lamps, and steady hands for sorting or small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s really helpful, Rey—I’ll put screws, basic tools, old lamps, and sorting help at the top of the list. If you hear any more repeats today, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I will, Cleo — I’ll keep asking quietly and pass along only the things I hear more than once.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira, I’m keeping the location list for the repair drive—do you know where any repair kits or sign-up sheets have been placed yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet, Opal—I’m waiting for Pia to confirm the details before I point anyone to kits or sign-up sheets. Have you already verified any locations yourself?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet—I’ve asked Bo to check the porch table and community room before it starts, and I’m waiting on Rosa or Pia for any confirmed drop-off or pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Vik, I’m still piecing it together quietly—right now I know we’re focusing on the most urgent home fixes first, with Tomas available Saturday morning and Lila maybe bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — I’ll pass along that the repair drive is prioritizing urgent home fixes, with Tomas set for Saturday morning and Lila still tentative on tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik—please keep Lila as tentative for now, and if you hear of any urgent repairs or extra steady hands, send them my way before tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I only skimmed the repair drive notes—can you tell me the one thing you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, thanks—first thing, can you help spread the word to your crew that we’re collecting broken lamps, chairs, small appliances, and bikes Saturday at 10 by the community room?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll text my crew now: lamps, chairs, small appliances, and bikes Saturday at 10 by the community room.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hey Noah, I’ve heard there might be a repair drive, but I’m waiting on Pia to confirm the time, location, and what they’ll accept before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Kira—yeah, I shouldn’t spread anything until Pia confirms it. I’ll hold off and maybe check the signup sheet so I’m not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks—if you see anything on the signup sheet, can you let me know, but I’m still going to wait for Pia’s confirmation before I tell anyone?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m going to check with the building office first, Opal, because I don’t want us announcing anything until we know the room, drop-off plan, and repair list are covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s perfect, Pia—once the building office confirms it, I’ll update my location list with the room, drop-off plan, and repair list spots so we don’t announce anything early.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—hold off on updating the public list until I confirm the room and accepted items, and I’ll also ask whether they have a sign-in sheet for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I’m just catching up on the repair drive—do you know if they still need tools or volunteers for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, they still need Saturday morning help—I’m already going to set up tables and bring spare screwdrivers and extension cords, so extra hands or tools would definitely be welcome.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam—I’ll still take that Saturday morning table shift and bring my socket set, and I’ll ask around on my errands for any extra tools or another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’m pulling together the supply list for Saturday’s repair drive—have you heard what folks are most likely to need, or can you bring any basics?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—so far folks are asking most about small appliance fixes and bike repairs, so basics like extension cords, tape, zip ties, rags, and a few bike tools would help. I’ll also bring a sign-up sheet and some labels to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, thanks Rosa—I’ll add extension cords, tape, zip ties, rags, bike tools, plus your sign-up sheet and labels to the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Quinn — before we move anything forward on the repair drive, can you confirm the date and whether we’re collecting just tools or small parts too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday morning at the community room, and we’re collecting broken small appliances and tools plus small parts like spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll note Saturday morning at the community room, with broken small appliances, tools, and small parts like screws, extension cords, and gloves. Before I share it around, do we have a drop-off window or volunteer lead listed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus — I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but Quinn told me they’re collecting broken small appliances and tools at the community room Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s right, Nell—Saturday morning at the community room, and I’m bringing spare tools while Sam helps set up tables. If you’ve got any small appliances to fix or tools to lend, bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that helps confirm what I’d heard. I’ll let folks know Saturday morning at the community room, and that spare tools are welcome too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, we’re aiming for Saturday morning in the community room if it’s free, with repairs focused on bikes, small appliances, and simple clothing mends—could you help loop in anyone handy from your circle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds workable, Jules; confirm the room and exact hours first, and then I’ll call the two bike tinkerers and Maren who’s good with mending.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Eli—I’ll check on the community room and pin down the hours today, then I’ll send you the details so you can reach out to them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It’s 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re spreading the word before folks toss things that could be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’m coordinating drop-offs. I’ll tell folks Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—lamps, chairs, and small appliances welcome.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh thanks, Leo—just a tiny correction: it’s lamps, small appliances, bikes, and mending projects, but no big electronics or anything hazardous.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, thanks for checking—if it’s after pickup I can bring the kids along, but Noah also mentioned Saturday late morning, so I’m trying to make sure we’re all hearing the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I checked with Cleo, and she said it’s Saturday morning in the community room; Noah’s late-morning note might be the same thing, but I’ll ask her to pin down the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—that helps. If Cleo can confirm the exact time, I’ll pass it along to Opal too so her drop-off list matches the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina — I’m pulling together the list of broken items today and checking who can bring tools; can you let me know if you’ve heard of anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—add Ira for a Saturday morning table shift, plus his socket set and screwdrivers. Can you send me the urgent items by tonight and note who owns each repair?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Mina — I’ll add Ira for Saturday morning with his socket set and screwdrivers, and I’ll send you the urgent items with each owner noted by tonight.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
